description: Creates a two-column sidebar and content layout.

attributes.name: content-width
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of the container width reserved for the content column. When absent, uses the --tp-sidebar-content-width CSS default.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between sidebar and content. When absent, uses --tp-sidebar-gap, with a fallback of 1rem.

attributes.name: right-sidebar
attributes.description: Uses the last child as the sidebar instead of the first child.

attributes.name: side-width
attributes.description: Preferred sidebar width before flex space is distributed. By default, uses the item's own width or content-based size through --tp-sidebar-side-width.

cssproperties.name: --tp-sidebar-gap
cssproperties.description: Default gap between sidebar and content.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-sidebar>` element implements the <tp-icon name="sidebar" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Sidebar functionality: creates a two-column sidebar and content layout.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Reading | Read or use the content in the side panel. Any links and controls inside it retain their usual actions. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Component itself | No dedicated keyboard action. |
| Embedded controls, when present | Use their normal keyboard interactions. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
